## Uploads over a certain size are refused. What is the default limit and the config option to raise it?

--- [vault:corpus/docs/Fonts.md] ---
### Editor font size

# Editor font size
**Editor font size**, also under **Appearance**, sets the size of page text in the editor, in pixels: 18 by default, from 10 to 48. Headings, code and list indents scale with it. A proportional font often looks smaller than a monospace one at the same size, so you may want to raise it after switching. In [[CONFIG]]:

```lua
config.set("fonts.editorSize", 20)
```

--- [vault:corpus/docs/Search.md] ---
### Semantic search > Space size

## Space size
Once a model is configured, spaces with up to 5,000 Markdown pages are eligible for semantic search by default. Larger spaces require explicit opt-in. A space that grows past this threshold keeps its existing semantic search and shows a warning about relevance. 5,000 is a default policy threshold, not a hard page limit. Full-text search remains available.
